newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Anzoil suspends third Vietnam oil well.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Anzoil suspends third Vietnam oil well.

text.p: Anzoil Ltd said on Monday its Song Thai Binh B10-x well in Vietnam's Hanoi Basin is being suspended as a potential oil producer.
The decision follows a pumping test on the well that averaged 227 barrels of oil per day over the last 6.5 hours, Anzoil said.
Song Tahi Binh is the last in Anzoil's current three-well exploration programme.
Anzoil earlier announced a gas discovery in the first exploration well, Song Tra Ly D14-X, while the second, Bac Son K2-1x, was plugged and abandoned.
Anzoil is conducting the exploration through its 80 percent-owned subsidiary, Anzoil (Asia) Pte Ltd.
The remaining 20 percent is held by Frontier Petroleum.
